title: Crypto Treasury Firms Pivot to AI in Bid to Win Back Investors
title_zh: 加密货币财政部公司转向人工智能以赢回投资者
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The implosion of the once-hot market for cryptocurrency treasury stocks is prompting a number of firms to pivot to artificial intelligence in an attempt to win back investors. So far, it isn’t working.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——曾经炙手可热的加密货币库存股市场的崩溃正促使许多公司转向人工智能，以试图赢回投资者。到目前为止，它还不起作用。

title: China Vows Response to US Sanctions Threat Against AI Firms
title_zh: 中国誓言回应美国对人工智能公司的制裁威胁
summary: (Bloomberg) -- China warned it would take “all necessary measures” if the US moves to sanction Chinese artificial intelligence companies over allegations they improperly used American models to train their own systems.Most Read from BloombergDeepSeek Suspends Fundraising After...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——中国警告称，如果美国因指控中国人工智能公司不当使用美国模型训练自己的系统而制裁中国人工智能公司，中国将采取“一切必要措施”。

title: Trump Says 660-Mile Highway in Disputed Sahara to Bear His Name
title_zh: 特朗普称争议撒哈拉地区 660 英里的高速公路将以他的名字命名
summary: (Bloomberg) -- US President Donald Trump said Morocco is naming a 1,055-kilometer (660 mile) highway in the Western Sahara after him, seemingly reflecting his landmark recognition of the kingdom’s rule of the disputed territory in 2020 that helped spur an investment boom.Most ...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，摩洛哥将以他的名字命名西撒哈拉一条全长 1,055 公里（660 英里）的高速公路，这似乎反映出他对摩洛哥在 2020 年统治这片有争议领土的里程碑式的认可，这有助于刺激投资热潮。

title: How Zynga changed gaming forever with FarmVille: Mark Pincus
title_zh: Zynga 如何通过 FarmVille 永远改变游戏：Mark Pincus
summary: Zynga founder Mark Pincus breaks down to Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi the explosive creation of Farmville, the hard truths of scaling a massive gaming empire, and what it was really like investing in a young Mark Zuckerberg during the early days of Facebook.
summary_zh: Zynga 创始人马克·平卡斯 (Mark Pincus) 向雅虎财经执行编辑布莱恩·索齐 (Brian Sozzi) 详细讲述了《Farmville》的爆炸性创作、扩大庞大游戏帝国的残酷事实，以及在 Facebook 早期投资年轻的马克·扎克伯格的真实感受。
